messages.en:
{07 1c 00}Phew{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00} {0b 03 00}{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0f 00}
thanks for helping me
collect that furniture.
{07 14 00}I think I've got all the
furniture I need for now,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 16 00}Any more collecting, and I'll
start to hate it!

{07 14 00}I think I'll find a new
hobby to get way into,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 00 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0f 00} you really
should stop taking care of
people.
{07 14 00}You've gotta think about 
what you want to do, 
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 1c 00}Uhh{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00} {0b 03 00}{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0f 00}
aitäh, et aitasid mul
seda mööblit koguda.
{07 14 00}Arvan, et mul on praegu
kogu vajalik mööbel,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 16 00}Veel kogumist ja ma
hakkan seda vihkama!

{07 14 00}Vist leian uue
hobi, millesse süveneda,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 00 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0f 00} sa peaksid
tõesti lõpetama teiste
eest hoolitsemise.
{07 14 00}Sa pead mõtlema sellele,
mida sina tahad teha,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

messages.en:
{07 00 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}Well, {04 1f 00},{01 00 00 14 00} I think
it's time to hang up my
furniture-collecting hat.
{07 14 00}I appreciate you teaching
me so much about furniture
collecting.
But I'm planning to find 
myself a new hobby,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 0a 00}I owe you one, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}Noh, {04 1f 00},{01 00 00 14 00} vist
on aeg mööblikogumise
müts varna riputada.
{07 14 00}Hindan seda, et õpetasid
mulle mööblikogumisest
nii palju.
Aga ma plaanin leida
endale uue hobi,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 0a 00}Olen sulle võlgu, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
